key_highlights: ASX slumps sharply as oil hits two-month high on US-Iran strikes, fuelling inflation and RBA rate hike fears; bond yields spike
Q2 GDP growth of 2.1% YoY beats expectations but raises probability of a fourth rate hike; economy narrowly avoids recession
Mortgage stress at 18-year highs; analysts warn 10% house price decline; mega developer Bathla warns of imminent collapse
Multiple high-grade mineral discoveries: Gateway gold (Wiluna), King River 44g/t gold, McLaren titanium surge, Mount Lyell copper reopening
CSL signs US deal to slash medicine prices under Trump administration; Qantas ground crews vote for strike rights
AUD weakens on Chinese Yuan strength; global debt spiral concerns mount

sectors.trend: Mixed: gold and base metal discoveries (Gateway, King River, McLaren, Mount Lyell, Larvotto) provide sector support, but ASX miners fell broadly on risk-off oil-driven selloff. Coal boom offers a counterweight.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GWN.AX, KCG.AX) and titanium/copper names benefit from discovery pipeline; BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX pressured by risk-off sentiment despite coal strength. Mount Lyell reopening supports copper supply narrative.

sectors.trend: Negative: banks fall on rate hike fears and 18-year high mortgage stress. CBA fee scandal (13 years on inactive card) adds reputational drag. Housing market bloodbath risk threatens NPLs.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cycle and housing downturn. Mortgage stress at 18-year highs signals rising credit losses ahead. REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) under pressure from rate sensitivity.

sectors.trend: Positive: oil at two-month high on US-Iran strikes; energy stocks lead in final August trading. Coal boom supports AGL.AX, WES.AX, SAN.AX.
sectors.implications: Energy names benefit from oil spike but face inflation-driven rate hike risk. Coal strength supports WES.AX and AGL.AX. LNG exporters (WDS.AX, GSO.AX) benefit from elevated energy prices.

sectors.trend: Mixed: CSL's US price-cutting deal with Trump administration caps revenue upside but secures market access. Sector otherwise defensive.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces margin compression from mandated price cuts; offset by volume. Defensive positioning intact but upside limited. SWH.AX, SGH.AX less affected.

sectors.trend: Negative: housing market bloodbath narrative, developer implosions (Bathla, Evergrande analogue), mortgage stress, and per-capita recession fears weigh on consumer confidence and property-linked names.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX, ICPS.AX) face rising discount rates. Consumer discretionary (WOW.AX, LSG.AX) pressured. Home builders (GPT.AX, MYR.AX) at risk from 10% price decline scenario.

sectors.trend: Mixed: Telstra outage investigation reveals governance gaps; Canva privacy legal fight; AI bubble concerns from Iran conflict. Jetstar/Western Sydney Airport launch is a positive infrastructure signal.
sectors.implications: TLS.AX faces regulatory and reputational risk from outage findings. CVA (Canva, US-listed) faces privacy litigation. AI infrastructure names (CSCO, SMCI) see volatility from geopolitical risk.

key_themes: RBA rate hike risk elevated by 2.1% GDP beat and oil-driven inflation
Housing market correction: 10% price decline, 18-year mortgage stress, developer defaults
Geopolitical oil shock: US-Iran strikes push oil to two-month high
Australian mineral discovery pipeline: gold, titanium, copper, antimony, coal
Productivity deterioration: 'bad to worse' with bureaucrat bloat cited
Global debt spiral and per-capita recession risk
CSL US pricing deal signals regulatory pressure on ASX healthcare exporters

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike triggered by oil-driven inflation and GDP beat
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour fixed-income ladders; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and developer defaults (Bathla, Evergrande analogue)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid home builders and property developers; favour cash-rich REITs with low gearing; monitor NPL trends at major banks

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Iran geopolitical escalation and oil price volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; maintain diversified commodity basket; monitor AUD/USD for risk-off flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs driving credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour banks with strong capital buffers (CBA.AX, NAB.AX); avoid high-LTV exposure; watch ASX bank NPL disclosures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Qantas industrial action and Telstra governance failure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor QAN.AX for strike escalation; assess TLS.AX governance remediation before re-entry

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global debt spiral and per-capita recession
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain cash reserves; favour dividend-paying defensives; reduce leverage

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and base metal miners on discovery pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Gateway, King River, McLaren, Mount Lyell, Larvotto discoveries signal strong Australian mineral pipeline; gold benefits from geopolitical risk and AUD weakness

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on energy names on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil at two-month high on US-Iran strikes; coal boom supports domestic energy; LNG exporters benefit from elevated prices

opportunities.recommendation: Mineral Resources re-entry on ASIC clearance
opportunities.rationale: ASIC investigation concluded with no action for Ellison; removes overhang on MRG.AX valuation

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price decline forecast, 18-year mortgage stress, developer defaults (Bathla) signal sector-wide credit risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank exposure pending rate decision and NPL data
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate hike risk plus mortgage stress threatens net interest margins and credit costs; CBA fee scandal adds reputational risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bonds as hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Global debt spiral, per-capita recession risk, and geopolitical oil shock favour liquidity and capital preservation

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil-driven inflation and RBA rate hike risk dominate. Housing correction and developer defaults create contagion risk for banks and REITs. Mining discovery pipeline provides selective pockets of strength. Expect elevated volatility on geopolitical headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive for commodity exporters (gold, copper, coal, LNG) supported by AUD weakness and global supply constraints. Housing market stabilisation likely by mid-2027. Productivity drag and bureaucrat bloat cap earnings growth. CSL US pricing deal may compress healthcare margins structurally. RBA likely to peak rates by Q1 2027, supporting a late-cycle recovery.
